name: Подвійний напад (2)
description:
A double attack is a great trick to attack two pieces at the same time. But you can also use it to attack a piece and a mating square. Your opponent has to protect the mating square (or he loses the game) and cannot save the piece as well.

 

What do you have to do?

Win material by attacking two things at the same time: two pieces, a piece and the king or a piece and a mating square.

examples.text: The black knights are unprotected. The white bishop makes good use of this with a double attack! Suddenly Black is in trouble. There is no way to save both knights.
